title: Memory model checkpoint
prompt: Implement `static (int copiedX, int aliasedY) AliasVsCopy()`. Inside: create a struct `S { public int X; }` with X=1, copy it to a second local and set the copy's X=2 (original must stay 1); then create an array `int[] a = {5}`, take a ref local `ref int r = ref a[0]`, set r=7. Return (original struct X, a[0]).

tests.name: copy-independence
tests.hint: Struct assignment copies; `ref` creates an alias that writes through.

tests.name: allocation-shape
tests.hint: The whole method should allocate at most the small array (and tuple) — no boxing, no string.
